简介: Brooke Holmewood is a British actress who plays Peermaid to Leida Mothma (Bronte Carmichael), in Star Wars Andor Season 2 (2025) starring alongside Genevieve O'Reilly (Mon Mothma), Alastair Mackenzie (Perrin Fertha), Faye Marsay (Vel Sartha), Stellan Skarsgard (Luthen Rael), and Finley Glasgow (Stekan Sculden). Brooke lives in London in the UK.
